sv.title: Vändningen: ”Fury lider inte av schizofreni”
sv.summary: I en ny Netflix-dokumentär säger Tyson Furys fru Paris att boxningsstjärnan lider av schizofreni. Nu tar hon tillbaka det uttalandet. ”Han har aldrig fått en sådan diagnos”, skriver Paris Fury.

en.title: The turnaround: "Fury does not suffer from schizophrenia"
en.summary: In a new Netflix documentary, Tyson Fury's wife Paris says the boxing star suffers from schizophrenia. Now she is taking that statement back. "He has never been given such a diagnosis", writes Paris Fury.
